关键词: amended and restated Program transaction agreements
主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada amended and restated its Program transaction agreements as part of a general update to increase the total credit commitment available under the Intercompany Loan Agreement, amended and restated as of July 24, 2015, between the Bank and the Guarantor LP to $60 billion. The amendments included updates to the Trust Deed, Master Definitions and Construction Agreement, and Agency Agreement, all effective as of July 31, 2015.
